tailoring.headline: Associate Staff Engineer, SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Java & Spring | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Associate Staff Engineer, Hybris
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Associate Staff Engineer, Hybris position at Nagarro. With over five years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and scaling enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for major global clients including Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, and engineered seamless data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems using Profisee, DataHub, and Hotfolders.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), optimized FlexibleSearch queries to improve transaction speed, and managed core modules including OMS, Promotions, and Cronjobs.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with business and technical stakeholders across international teams to analyse requirements, translate them into scalable solutions, and ensure high-quality delivery in agile environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise aligns with Nagarro's goals.

tailoring.why_company: Nagarro's reputation for delivering complex digital engineering solutions and driving technological excellence makes it an exciting environment for my SAP Commerce expertise. I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise experience building robust Hybris platforms, integrating enterprise systems, and collaborating with international teams to deliver high-impact results.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell to drive scalable e-commerce engineering at Nagarro.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Associate Staff Engineer role at Nagarro. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Associate Staff Engineer, Hybris - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Associate Staff Engineer, Hybris position at Nagarro. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and system integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
